detail.longDescription: Hey folks. Most all the apps I see for agent harnesses are typescript based, and involve either electron or some form of IPC to function as a desktop app. In the age of LLM's, I thought it would be cool to build out a prototype of what a modern desktop application would like for this, without using any web code, since I can have agents pretty aggressively work on the cross-platform compatibility on my behalf. After about a week, I ended up with a harness that feels pretty good! Feel free to try it from the releases or you can install directly via: ``` cargo install byob ````
